_note: Partners. Each candidate gets a name, a job and a quirk. Jobs carry a weekly effect while you're together. Dates cost a time slot and money.

jobs.blurb: Works nights. Has seen things. Unbothered by your 'injuries'.
Can silence a room with one look. Uses it on you.
41k followers. Every date is content. Every meal goes cold.
Talks about cows a lot. More than you'd think. More than you'd want.
Describes your bedroom as 'compact, with character'.
Never sleeps. Somehow always has a gig in Ibiza.
Studying the mating habits of snails. Brings it up on dates.
Has strong opinions about your fringe. Correct opinions.

quirks: has a pet ferret called Gary
knows every word of Mamma Mia
has never seen a single film
meet: You met at Shaz's party, by the foam machine.
You matched on an app. Their first message was a picture of a sausage roll. Bold.
Deano set you up. Deano's never been right about anything. Until now?
You bumped trolleys in the big the big Shopco. Coco Pops everywhere.

dates.label: Chippy tea on the seafront
lines: A seagull takes your fishcake. They laugh so hard they snort. You're in love.

dates.label: Cluckers (extra hot, to impress)
lines: You order extra hot. You cry. They hold your hand. It's lovely, actually.

dates.label: Cinema date
lines: You both fall asleep. Best date ever.

dates.label: Posh restaurant
lines: The starter is a single pea on a spoon. You go to the Burger Barn after.

dates.label: Weekend away
lines: A cottage in the Lake District. It rains for 48 hours. You don't notice.

dates.label: Stargazing on a hill with a flask of hot chocolate
lines: You point out a shooting star. It's a plane. They kiss you anyway.

dates.label: Walk in the park with takeaway coffees
lines: You feed the ducks. A duck bites you. They film it. It's quite romantic, in the end.

dates.label: Seaside arcade and a bag of 2p coins
lines: Forty minutes trying to win a keyring. You win it. You give it to them. They put it on their keys straight away.

dates.label: Crazy golf
lines: They get a hole in one through the windmill. You will hear about this for the rest of your life.

dates.label: Picnic in the park
lines: The sandwiches are soggy and a wasp joins you. Neither of you cares. You're both crying with laughter.

dates.label: Pub quiz
lines: You know every football question. They know everything else. You win a tin of biscuits and a lifelong team name.

dates.label: Takeaway and a film on the sofa
lines: You argue about which film for an hour. You end up watching a baking show. Perfect.

dates.label: Ten-pin bowling
lines: Gutter ball. Then another. They get a strike and do a little dance. You let them have it.

dates.label: Ice skating
lines: You cling to the side the whole time while they glide round you, giggling. Your pride is bruised. So is your bum.

dates.label: Karaoke night
lines: You murder a power ballad. They do the harmonies. Somehow it works.

dates.label: Paintball
lines: They shoot you in the back within thirty seconds. You've never been prouder.

dates.label: Day at the zoo
lines: A penguin falls over. You both fall over laughing. A keeper asks you to keep it down.

dates.label: Escape room
lines: You don't escape. The final clue was the door handle. You blame each other, lovingly.

dates.label: Comedy club
lines: The comedian picks on your haircut. They laugh so hard they cry. You'll get your own back.

dates.label: Cooking class
lines: You set fire to a crêpe. The chef sighs. They think you're hilarious.

dates.label: Gig in town
lines: You lose your voice singing along. They lose a shoe in the crowd. You find it. Hero.

dates.label: Theme park
lines: You scream on the big rollercoaster. They buy the photo. They will always have the photo.

dates.label: Wine tasting at a vineyard
lines: You swirl, you sniff, you announce 'notes of blackcurrant'. It's a rosé. They adore you for trying.

dates.label: Theatre trip and dinner
lines: The musical makes you cry. They pretend not to notice. They definitely noticed.

dates.label: Spa day
lines: Fluffy dressing gowns, cucumber water, and you fall asleep in the hot tub. Bliss.

dates.label: Glamping in a yurt
lines: Fairy lights, a wood burner and a sky full of stars. You burn every single marshmallow.

dates.label: Chef's table tasting menu
lines: Fourteen courses. One is a foam. Another is a smaller foam. You hold hands under the table.

dates.label: Hot-air balloon ride at sunrise
lines: You float over the fields at dawn. They hold your hand. You try very hard not to look down.

dates.label: City break abroad
lines: Cobbled streets, tiny coffees, and you get lost for three hours. Best bit of the trip.

dates.label: Private yacht for the afternoon
lines: The captain calls you 'sir'. You get seasick. They rub your back. Romance isn't dead.

dates.label: Helicopter tour over the city
lines: You point out your house. It's not your house. They love you anyway.
